classData.comment:
/**
 * @summary Renders a pooled `Neo.component.Progress` cell bound to `record[dataField]`, animating width changes only on in-place updates of the same record.
 * @class Neo.grid.column.Progress
 * @extends Neo.grid.column.Component
 */
classData.summary: Renders a pooled `Neo.component.Progress` cell bound to `record[dataField]`, animating width changes only on in-place updates of the same record.
classData.name: Progress

classData.comment:
/**
         * Smoothly transitions bar width when an already-bound record updates in place (`component[recordProperty] === record`).
         * Pooled row recycling (`scroll`, `sort`, `filter`) omits `.neo-progress-animate` so recycled cells snap immediately.
         * @member {Boolean} useTransition=true
         */
classData.description: Smoothly transitions bar width when an already-bound record updates in place (component[recordProperty] === record). Pooled row recycling (scroll, sort, filter) omits .neo-progress-animate so recycled cells snap immediately.
classData.name: useTransition

classData.comment:
/**
     * @summary Maps `record[dataField]` to `value` and toggles `'neo-progress-animate'` exclusively for same-record updates.

     * @param {Object} [data]
     * @returns {Object}
     */
classData.summary: Maps `record[dataField]` to `value` and toggles `'neo-progress-animate'` exclusively for same-record updates.
classData.name: applyRecordConfigs
